description: What do Japanese households spend on and do, and where does local money flow?. Japanese household facts from official statistics: yearly spending per household on 620 items with COICOP codes (2025), participation and days per year for 80 leisure and sports activities, household consumption by 301 input-output sectors (2020), counts of households and firms by area, and municipal money flows per prefecture (taxes in, transfers in, spending out, FY2019-2024). Facts only; no personal data. Routes: /io (q); /actors (kind, q); /spending (q); /activities (q); /local-flows (pref, year). Paid $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /io, /actors, /spending, /activities, /local-flows. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
